verdict.rationale: Llama is a model family. llama.com references agent-related features, including function calling, agent-optimized inference and a 'Multi-agent coding in your terminal' tagline, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents setting up automations, scheduled or recurring tasks, or autonomous background execution. Function calling and agent-optimized inference are only developer building blocks for constructing such automations, which earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
